$comment: Single source of truth for the Radio Group API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: radio-group
title: Radio Group
description: Pick exactly one option from a short list.
thumb: DailyWeekly

label.description: The group's name, shown as the legend.

value / defaultValue.description: The chosen value (controlled or not). Use onValueChange to hear about changes.

name.description: Form field name. Generated if you leave it out.
name.html: name attribute (the same on every radio)

error.description: An error message. Also marks the radios invalid.

disabled.html: disabled on the fieldset, or on one radio

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Native radios in a fieldset. The legend names the group, and ↑ ↓ move between options with no JavaScript. Uses the same label layout as Checkbox.

examples.title: Horizontal
examples.description: Short options can sit in a row. A disabled option stays readable.

examples.title: Cards
examples.description: Bigger targets with a description each, for plans and other important choices. The whole card is clickable.

a11y: Native <input type="radio"> with one shared name: arrow keys move and select, Tab enters and leaves the group.
A <fieldset> with a <legend> gives the group its name.
Every radio has a <label for>; descriptions are linked with aria-describedby.
In cards, the label covers the whole card, so the click target is large and still one labelled control.
Visible focus ring in every style and mode.
